My Favorite Restaurant in Da Nang
Feb 2025 • Solo
Khong is my favorite restaurant in Da Nang. The environment is very clean and pleasant with good WiFi. It’s reassuring knowing that there is no MSG – which all vegan restaurants cannot say. 

Must-trys are the Banana Chacha smoothie bowl, Red Rumba (dragon fruit) smoothie bowl, curry, coconut coffee, toast, and broccoli wings. 

The waiter is extremely nice, fluent in English, knowledgeable about the menu, sensitive about food allergies, and humble – so much so that he did not want to be named here. 

Prices are fair too. Check it out!

The best comfort and Vietnamese food yet!
Feb 2020 • Couples
We heard about this place from a couple we met at the beach and we are so glad to have come. We ordered Mi Quang and mango smoothies and all of it was sooo delicious. The smoothies were perfectly smooth and sweet and the Mi Quang was so hearty and full of flavour. It was the best meal we have had so far in Vietnam. It was also really cheap (35k for most things). We came for lunch the next day and ordered the same thing plus a coconut coffee which was also delicious. We then came for dinner and had the pho and mixed smoothies and again, unsurprisingly it was fantastic. This restaurant is located directly in front of the TS mart with a brown picket fence. The vibe here is really chill and the menu is small but the fact that the food is so good makes up for it. The owner is sooo sweet and cheerful. Everything is made with love and care and it shows. Usually we don’t go to vegan restaurants as my boyfriend likes his protein, but we both left full of food and smiles.
